shot_purpose: 把固定中心旋转和中心可移动的真正问题分开。
edit_in: 圆盘直觉画面硬切到粉笔板。
edit_out: 顺着粉笔箭头切到多方向线段扇面。
screen_direction: 粉笔从左边错误规则移动到右边正确规则。
mathematical_locks: Unit segment must be visibly length 1 with two endpoints; the condition is all directions, not a fixed center unless shown as a rejected intuition.

continuity.in: 圆盘直觉画面硬切到粉笔板。
continuity.out: 顺着粉笔箭头切到多方向线段扇面。

reject_if: Text too readable/modern; use simple symbols
start/key/end frames do not form the stated action chain
camera motion hides the action peak or reverses the declared screen direction
Female Byleth becomes male Byleth, an adult mentor, a generic sorceress, or an ordinary student
the unit segment loses visible endpoints or becomes a decorative sword without length meaning
